title: ai-economics-mcp: calculators for AI cost, energy and verification, as MCP tools
description:
Twelve deterministic calculators exposed as Model Context Protocol tools, so an agent can price its own work instead of estimating it: token cost across GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek with prompt-cache discount; context-window sizing; fully-loaded agent-hour cost including human review; model-routing savings; LLM energy, cost and CO2; joules per verified task; Proof-Adjusted Autonomy; revocation exposure; and proof debt. Every response carries the formula it used, so the number can be checked rather than trusted.

No API key and no account. Inputs are never stored. Interactive versions of the same calculators are at https://piszczek.pl/tools, which also serves the same math as a free keyless HTTP API with an OpenAPI 3.1 specification.
